narrative: Three small apples on a leaded windowsill, yellow and red, one bruised. Grey October light, not yet warm. Beyond the glass, the church porch and bare elms sit soft and far. No moon. No person. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood at the window and did not touch the apples.

entities.name: the west window
entities.context: In photo: Apples on the sill
